description: Fetch one customer by GraphQL global Customer ID via the `node` query. Returns id, legacyId, name, company, and created-at. To also enumerate stored cards/PayPal accounts use braintree_customer_payment_methods.

id.description: GraphQL global Customer ID (opaque). Legacy numeric ids differ — resolve them via a transaction search or the id-conversion query first.

name: braintree_find_customer
title: Find a customer
